long_biography.plain_text:
Kenneth Long’s entry into community pharmacy required a second shop: his father’s original store already had enough pharmacists. After Long graduated in 1980, his father bought another location in Columbia, giving him a place in the family business. Father and son worked as partners for two decades, acquiring pharmacies as opportunities arose.

As chief executive, Long visited every store each week, maintaining personal contact as the company reached 23 locations across three states. In 2009, he endowed a scholarship in his parents’ names at the University of South Carolina for students planning careers in independent community pharmacy.
